title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the predictions of a model will change if we use a different training dataset. High variance means the model is sensitive to the specific data it was trained on.

title: Effect of Removing a Feature
text: When you remove a feature from a model, you are simplifying the model. Think about how this simplification might affect the model's sensitivity to the training data.
